# Test files a dedicated job in .github/workflows/tests.yml runs, so the unit sweep skips them.
#
# The sweep runs `ls tests/test_*.py` minus this list. A file belongs here only when another job
# names it (it needs a toolchain, launcher or service the sweep lacks, or runs in a heavier
# phase); tests/test_ci_coverage.py fails on an entry no job names or a file that does not exist.
# One path per line; `#` comments and blank lines are ignored.
